document_title: MURU External Validation Preregistration Draft JSON
status: DRAFT — FROZEN DESIGN ONLY — DO NOT EXECUTE

G_PERM.name: Publication Permission Gate
G_PERM.description: Requires documented written consent from WFSR prior to public dissemination of any WFSR-derived MURU result.

G_LOCK.name: MURU Implementation Lock Gate
G_LOCK.description: Requires binding to a frozen implementation commit hash from the synthetic benchmark before execution.

G_INTEGRITY.name: Input Integrity Verification Gate
G_INTEGRITY.description: Requires verification of retrieval hashes and reproduction of candidate census before any computation.

splitting_protocol.scaffold_algorithm: RDKit Bemis-Murcko scaffold on representative deposited structure
splitting_protocol.allocation_strategy: Grouped folds size-balancing (largest scaffold group first, assigned to fold furthest below compound target)
splitting_protocol.stratification: NONE (Stratification on mass or descriptors is prohibited to avoid pre-conditioning mass comparisons)
splitting_protocol.timing: Assigned at Stage S2 prior to any mu calculation

input_integrity_gates.I1: Retrieval hash and byte count recorded and non-empty
input_integrity_gates.I2: Census reproduction against frozen feasibility reference
input_integrity_gates.I3: Spectrum availability for all trajectory cells
input_integrity_gates.I5: Identity consistency (InChIKey, SMILES, adduct) across trajectory
input_integrity_gates.I6: Precursor m/z consistency within 5 ppm of trajectory median

U1.name: Energy-Dependent Truncation
U1.metric: Within-compound range of min m/z across NCE > 20 Da OR |rho(min m/z, NCE)| >= 0.30

U2.name: Mass-Proportional Truncation
U2.metric: Fraction of spectra with min m/z / precursor_mz > 0.25

U3.name: Truncation Non-Invariance
U3.metric: Median |mu - mu^(c)| > 0.02 OR within-energy Spearman(mu, mu^(c)) < 0.95

U4.name: Sparse Spectral Support
U4.metric: Fraction of spectra with < 3 peaks > 0.05 OR < 5 peaks > 0.20

primary_scalar_gate.composition: E1a AND E1b AND E1c AND E1d

E1a.name: Held-Out Trajectory Prediction
E1a.metric: MAE(test trajectory vs Phi(E/g)) <= 0.80 * MAE(test trajectory vs training per-energy mean baseline)
E1a.threshold: Lower bound of Competence Rate >= 0.70 on both scaffold-bootstrap (2000 resamples) and Wilson interval

E1b.name: Model Adequacy Ladder (M0)
E1b.metric: Leave-one-energy-out error ratio vs M1 (shape heterogeneity), M2 (high-energy floor), M3 (low-energy ceiling)
E1b.decision_rule: M0 not rejected (lower bound of compound-clustered bootstrap error ratio <= 1.0)

E1c.name: Boundary Hit Ceiling
E1c.metric: Fraction of held-out compounds landing on profile optimization search bounds
E1c.threshold: Upper 95% bound <= 0.20 on both scaffold-bootstrap and Wilson interval

E1d.name: Profile Subsample Stability
E1d.metric: Pairwise Spearman correlation of log(g) across K=5 scaffold-disjoint training subsamples

criteria.B1: Selected expression effective support (elasticity > 0.02) contains >= 1 non-mass Tier A block
criteria.B2: Test fold weighted R2 exceeds strong mass baseline (MASS_SIMPLE or MASS_FLEX) with bootstrap diff lower bound > 0
criteria.B3: Validation R2 exceeds per-complexity null threshold (N1/N2/N3) and mass-improvement exceeds N4 threshold
criteria.B4: Non-mass block survives mass-preserving null N4
criteria.B5: Block-level support stable across >= 20 of 30 search seeds

N1.name: Descriptor Permutation Null
N1.preserves: Descriptor joint distribution, collinearity, g distribution, trajectories

N2.name: Scalar Target Permutation Null
N2.destroys: Descriptor to g association (from target side)
N2.preserves: Descriptor values in place, g marginal distribution, trajectories

N3.name: Scaffold-Aware Permutation Null
N3.destroys: Between-scaffold descriptor to g signal not attributable to scaffold group

N4.name: Mass-Preserving Null
N4.preserves: Mass to g relation exactly, precursor_mz attached to compound, all marginals

null_hypotheses_constructions.prohibited_null: Within-compound energy permutation across mu(E) is strictly prohibited as a scalar-target null (destroys trajectory definition).

terminal_outcome_tokens: EXTERNAL STRUCTURE BEYOND MASS NOT SUPPORTED
